proves: A renamed file still anchors by its NEW path. A reviewer reporting the old path would post a comment on a file that no longer exists.

expectedFindings.rationale: The regex `.test()` coerces its argument, so a non-string throws a TypeError instead of returning false. The previous implementation was safe for every input.

expectedNoFindings: The rename itself is not a defect.

forbiddenFindings.reason: the old path does not exist post-rename
